statements.subject: tcp
statements.description: A TCP implementation that supports the mitigation described in RFC 5961 SHOULD first check that the sequence number exactly matches RCV.NXT prior to executing the action in the next paragraph.
actions: verify SEG.SEQ = RCV.NXT before executing RST processing action

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: This step should be reached only if the ACK is ok, or there is no ACK, and the segment did not contain a RST.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: SND.UNA should be advanced to equal SEG.ACK (if there is an ACK), and any segments on the retransmission queue that are thereby acknowledged should be removed.
statements.pre_cond: protocol.state = SYN-SENT & segment.SYN = 1 & security.compartment_match = true & segment.ACK = 1
actions: remove acknowledged segments from retransmission queue

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Data or controls that were queued for transmission MAY be included.
statements.pre_cond: protocol.state = SYN-SENT & segment.SYN = 1 & segment.ACK = 1 & SND.UNA > ISS
actions: optionally include queued data or controls in outgoing ACK segment
